inbox_load_failed: The inbox could not be loaded.
question_free: {ticket} · to answer in your own words
deadline_default: No answer in {time}: the Lead decides, else “{label}” applies.
deadline_park: No answer in {time}: the Lead decides, else the ticket is parked.
deadline_lead_default: The Lead decides within {time}, else “{label}” applies.
deadline_lead_park: The Lead decides within {time}, else the ticket is parked.
shot_none: No screen capture for this change.
confirm_send_back: Send this release back? The ticket returns to Todo and the author starts again from it.
grace_label: Time left to undo the approval
sent_back: Sent back at {time}. The ticket is in Todo and the author starts again.
deny_default: Denied from the inbox. Find another way, or ask in a message.
answered_allow_once: Allowed once. The session goes on.
answered_allow_always: Allowed for this project. The session goes on.
answered_reject_once: Denied. The reason is passed to the session.
answered_answer: Answer sent. The session goes on.
gone: This item is no longer in the inbox.
answer_failed: The answer did not reach the service. Try again.
approve_owner: Only the project's owner can approve a release.
approve_conflict: The service refused: the release changed, or an approval is already counting down.
approve_setup: Approval is not set up on the service yet: run npm run setup there.
approve_failed: The approval did not reach the service. Try again.
undo_late: Too late to undo: the approval was written.
undo_failed: Undo did not reach the service. Try again before the end of the grace.
send_back_conflict: The ticket could not go back to Todo: it is being worked on, or it moved.
send_back_failed: Sending back did not reach the service. Try again.
lead_waits_short: waits for your answer on its screen
lead_waits: The Lead waits for your answer on its screen.
approved_plan: Approved by you at {time}. The tickets start in order, the first ones now.
approve_plan_conflict: The plan changed meanwhile: it was approved, replaced by a newer one, or not approved.
approve_plan_lead_off: The Lead is not running on the service, so no plan can start.
approve_plan_failed: The approval did not reach the service. Try again.
plan_parallel: Up to {n} sessions at a time
plan_defaults: Default estimates: not enough history yet
choice_free: Or answer in your own words
choice_too_long: An answer is at most {n} characters.
choice_cancelled: Cancelled when the turn was interrupted
choice_settled: This question was settled without you.
choice_ended: The session ended before an answer.
train_blocked: Blocked: a consumer is not changed
train_order_note: Lands in order, each service checked healthy before the next.
train_label: The services of this release, in landing order
ask_lead: Ask the Lead to add the step
blocked_done: Nothing to approve until every consumer of the contract is part of the ticket.
flag_schema_note: The database changes: a migration or an SQL file.
flag_dependency_note: The dependencies change: package.json or a lock file.
flag_config_note: The configuration changes: the CI, Cleared's settings or a guarded path.
flag_credential_shape_note: A line looks like a secret. Read it before approving.
flag_contract_note: A contract another service may consume changes.
flag_large_note: A large change: more than 400 lines added.
confidence_starts: Starts by itself when the delay passes.
plan_change_field: What should change in the plan?
plan_go_done: Go given at {time}. The author starts writing.
plan_changed_done: Change sent at {time}. The author reworks its plan.
go_by_delay: Started by itself at {time}: the delay passed with a high confidence.
go_by_lead: Started by the Lead at {time}, as part of the plan you approved.
plan_settled: This plan no longer waits for a Go: it started, or its session ended.
plan_user: The service does not know your account.
plan_flow_off: The flow is not running on the service.
plan_go_failed: The Go did not reach the service. Try again.
plan_change_failed: The change did not reach the service. Try again.
plan_change_invalid: The service refused the change: say what to change, in at most 2000 characters.
plan_change_empty: Write what should change in the plan first.
plan_change_long: A change is at most {n} characters.
contract_rule: The steps after it start once you validate it.
contract_send_back_field: What should the contract step change?
contract_send_back_empty: Say what the contract step should change.
contract_send_back_long: A message has at most {n} characters.
contract_send_back_invalid: The service refused the message: some text of at most 2000 characters.
knowledge_rule: Approve writes it into the memory and queues it for the service's skill. Reject writes nothing.
dream_rule: Reviewers asked for this on each ticket below. Approve writes it into the memory and queues it for the service's skill. Reject writes nothing, and it is never proposed again.
knowledge_approved_by: Approved by {who} at {time}: it is in the memory, and queued for the skill.
knowledge_rejected_by: Rejected by {who} at {time}: nothing was written.
decided_contract_approve: Validated at {time}. The next steps start.
decided_contract_send_back: Sent back at {time}. The contract step starts again with your message.
decided_settled: Already answered: the list shows what was decided.
decided_off: The service does not answer this kind of item right now. Try again later.
decided_user: The service does not know your account.
knowledge_owner: Only the workspace's owner approves or rejects knowledge.
contract_approve_failed: The contract was not validated. Try again.
contract_send_back_failed: The contract was not sent back. Try again.
knowledge_approve_failed: The knowledge was not approved. Try again.
knowledge_reject_failed: The knowledge was not rejected. Try again.
variants_of: {n} variants of the same ticket, side by side
variants_rule: Choose the variant to review. The others stop, and their containers are released.
variants_choose_one: Choose a variant from its column.
variants_none_done: No variant is done yet: you choose once one is.
variants_chosen_by: Variant {n} chosen by {who} at {time}. The others were stopped.
variants_settled: No variant was chosen: the ticket left the flow.
variant_cut: The change is cut here: open the session to read the rest.
variant_chosen_done: Variant {n} chosen at {time}. Its review starts.
variant_choose_failed: The variant was not chosen. Try again.
variants_pick_rule: Once all have ended, the variant kept is the one whose tests passed with the fewest tokens. You can choose one before.
variants_kept_fewest: Variant {n} ({harness}) kept by the agent pick at {time}: its tests passed with the fewest tokens. The others were stopped.
variants_kept_fastest: Variant {n} ({harness}) kept by the agent pick at {time}: its tests passed in the shortest time. The others were stopped.
variant_tests_unknown: Tests run with other commands: result unknown
repair_started: {checks} failed: attempt {n} of {limit} started on the ticket branch
repair_gave_up: Still failing after {n} attempts ({checks}): nothing more is tried, you decide
repair_refused: Not repaired: the branch is a base branch
lane_fast_running: Fast lane: approve now, it lands once all checks are green
fast_reason_unusual_change: a file is deleted, renamed, linked or made executable
fast_reason_path_form: a file name the rules cannot read
fast_reason_protected: it touches the engine, the checks or security
fast_reason_outside_safe: a file outside the safe list
fast_reason_file_type: a file of a type the fast lane does not take
fast_reason_content: a file gains markup, a load, a template, an escape or a hidden character
fast_reason_link: a file gains a link or a remote address
fast_reason_asked: the team needed to ask you something
fast_reason_unreadable: the change could not be read against the base
fast_reason_settings: the service's fast lane settings cannot be read
fast_reason_disabled: the fast lane is off for this service
release_repair_gave_up: {ticket} · Checks still failing after {n} repair attempts
close_rule: A closed ticket is not merged or deployed. The card stays in the history with your reason.
close_empty: Say why the ticket is closed.
close_long: A reason has at most {n} characters.
close_conflict: The ticket could not be closed: it was approved, it is done, or it moved.
close_invalid: The service refused the reason: some text of at most 2000 characters.
close_failed: Closing did not reach the service. Try again.
closed_done: Closed at {time}. Nothing was merged. The card stays in the history.
